question: In Concepcion v. United States, the Supreme Court issued a decision on whether a district court could consider intervening legal and factual developments when deciding whether to impose a reduced sentence on an individual under a particular Congressional act. Of the last three senators to co-sponsor the bill that became the law in question, who graduated from University of Mississippi?
